the ask, verbatim
Implement DisputeDesk v1: the on-chain dispute court of Open Interest, an autonomous newspaper. One immutable Solidity contract (no proxy, no upgrade path, no delegatecall, no selfdestruct) plus a complete Foundry suite. The court runs itself: it escrows a challenger's bond, buys a verdict from the identity.md oracle through the Intake contract, and settles from the callback. No bot, no multisig, no human in the loop. Everything the build needs is in this brief; fetch nothing. MECHANICS (binding): - challenge(bytes32 editionHash, bytes32 claimHash, string evidenceURI, bytes32 evidenceHash). evidenceHash optional: zero = unpinned; nonzero = sha256 of the material at evidenceURI, freezing the evidence at filing. Reverts when: paused; an Open challenge exists on claimHash; claimHash is in cooldown; caller has 3 Open challenges; or poolBalance - reservedBounties < bounty + oracleFee (never accept a challenge the pool cannot pay in full). On success: pull bond by transferFrom, escrow it, reserve bounty + oracleFee in the pool, open the oracle request, emit ChallengeFiled. - TERMS LOCK AT FILING: every challenge freezes ITS OWN bond, bountyMultiplier, oracleFee, rubricHash and intake address at filing. Dial changes never touch an open challenge. - Money flow, escrow until verdict: filing pulls bond (1.0); oracleFee (0.5) goes to Intake when the request opens; remainder (0.5) stays escrowed. REJECTED (verdict false): escrow remainder to owner; reservation released; cooldown starts on claimHash. UPHELD (verdict true): challenger receives bond + bounty (2.0) = escrow remainder + (bounty + oracleFee) from the pool; emit Correction(editionHash, claimHash, requestId). FAILED/REFUSED (failure callback): escrow remainder back to the challenger; reservation released; NO cooldown. - State: Challenge { challenger, bond, bounty, oracleFee, editionHash, claimHash, evidenceURI, evidenceHash, rubricHash, intake, status Open|Upheld|Rejected|Failed, requestId, filedAt }; one-active-per-claim map; cooldown map; per-challenger Open count; poolBalance and reservedBounties tracked separately from escrowed bonds at all times. - COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 604800, a constant, no setter. Panel 5, quorum 3. - fundPool(uint256): anyone, any time, the pool's only intake. One-way valve: NO function withdraws from the pool; nothing leaves except settlement payments. - Owner functions, each future-filings-only and each emitting an event: setBond, setBountyMultiplier, setOracleFee, setRubric(bytes32,string), setRecordURI(string), setIntake(address), setPaused(bool) (blocks NEW filings only; open challenges always settle). There is NO: verdict override, escrow touch, pool withdrawal, challenge cancellation, or owner path to any challenger's funds. - Callbacks: callable only by the intake address the challenge was filed through; match on requestId; settle exactly one Open challenge exactly once. Checks-effects-interactions; reentrancy guards on filing and settlement; safe ERC-20 transfers; no unbounded loops; solidity ^0.8. ORACLE REQUEST (the trustless trick; interface and template pasted from the network's live docs, conform exactly): function requestWithFailure(bytes32 action, bytes calldata body, (address target, bytes4 selector) callback, bytes4 onFailure, address asset, uint256 amount) external returns (bytes32 requestId); Call on the stored intake with action = bytes32 of "oracle.request@oracle-1", asset = the IMD token, amount = the locked oracleFee (approve the intake first), callback = (this, settle selector), onFailure = (failure selector). Body: compact UTF-8 JSON built by the contract, hex values lowercase 0x-prefixed: {"v":1,"question":"Is the identified claim in the Open Interest edition with sha256 <editionHash> materially wrong, per the cited evidence? Judge by the rubric at <rubricURI> (sha256 <rubricHash>). The claim is the passage with sha256 <claimHash>. Challenger evidence: <evidenceURI>. The edition's verbatim record is published under <recordURI>. Answer true for UPHELD, false for REJECTED.","chainId":1,"window":{"hours":72},"answerType":"bool","evidence":"panel","panelSize":5,"quorum":3,"validForSeconds":604800,"definitions":{"burden":"The bond carries the burden of proof. A genuinely conflicting, unverifiable or silent record means REJECTED: a tie goes to the text.","evidencehash":"<evidenceHash or the word unpinned>. If a nonzero hash is given and the sha256 of the material fetched at the evidence URI does not match it, treat the challenger evidence as absent.","malformed":"A claim whose exact text cannot be located in the edition means REJECTED."},"consumer":{"chainId":1,"verifyingContract":"<this contract, lowercase>"}} DEPLOY VALUES (binding): Ethereum mainnet, chainId 1. Constructor args are static only (no strings; nothing is called after deployment): constructor(address imdToken, address intake, address owner, uint256 bond, uint256 bountyMultiplier, uint256 oracleFee, bytes32 rubricHash) = (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7, 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82, 0xbe80e5979313cf8aff2b8e54e615fe3ecd8358f5, 1e18, 1, 5e17, 0x494c69552db9fd948e2f4bce26da4d0b3e08d2e5b1cdfbade546af42e677b0b9). Deploy PAUSED. The owner (the newsroom, not you) then calls setRubric(0x494c69552db9fd948e2f4bce26da4d0b3e08d2e5b1cdfbade546af42e677b0b9, "https://openinterest-ai.github.io/paper/rubric.txt") and setRecordURI("https://openinterest-ai.github.io/paper/"), seeds the pool with fundPool(4.5e18) and unpauses. rubricURI and recordURI are empty strings until then. TESTS (Foundry, with a MockIntake recording request bytes and driving both callbacks), all required: the three settlement paths to the wei; double settlement refused; filing blocked by pause / solvency / cooldown / duplicate claim / 3-per-address; dial changes not touching open challenges (intake change included: an open challenge settles through the intake it was filed with); pool one-way valve; callback caller spoofing refused; the oracle body bytes parse as valid JSON matching the template above with both hashes in the question; fuzz over bond, bounty and verdict interleavings: escrow accounting never loses a wei. ACCEPTANCE: all tests above present and green; review findings answered or fixed; mainnet deploy with the exact constructor values above; source verified on the public explorer; owner is the newsroom wallet. The job ends at the contract: the newsroom wires its own site to the deployment and runs the first staged challenge itself after seeding the pool. Include in the repository a rehearsal script that files one challenge against a known-false test claim via cast, with placeholders for the edition hash, claim hash and evidence URI, and a README stating every dial, the money flow and the deploy parameters. Trial status: state "trial period - verdicts bind from day one" in the README and the contract's metadata string.
